On Local machine

```bash
ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -f C:\Users\aubarnes\.ssh\id_rsa
```

then copy the content and paste it in the following file on the remote machine

```bash
~/.ssh/authorized_keys
```

Then on config file of LOCAL MACHINE uses:

```bash
Host 1APP_Prod
    HostName one01-3567-psc.eitc.rutgers.edu
    User ruadmin
    IdentityFile C:\Users\aubarnes\.ssh\id_rsa
```
